target_interpretation: Future/outcome pavement roughness represented by International Roughness Index. Higher IRI means rougher/worse pavement condition.
selection_rationale: Baseline selected model recommended because advanced tuning produced only negligible RMSE/R² improvement while MAE was slightly worse. For pavement management, this does not justify added advanced-model tuning complexity.

baseline_vs_advanced_tradeoff.operational_interpretation: Advanced RMSE improvement is negligible in pavement IRI units while MAE is worse; therefore baseline is preferred for reporting/deployment-readiness unless future diagnostics show materially better high-IRI or threshold-crossing behavior.
